text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Satellaview was a satellite-based expansion released for the Super Nintendo in Japan in 1995. It allowed users to download games, magazines, and other content through satellite broadcasts from St.GIGA. Some titles included enhanced versions of Super Famicom games, original broadcasts, and the BS Zelda series. Data was stored on special memory cartridges connected to the adapter. The service provided time-limited content and demonstrated an early attempt at digital game distribution.
